title: 商业世界模型
summary: 提出商业世界模型（BWM）概念与架构，将世界模型思想应用于商业环境，通过编码业务状态、动态、约束、目标和可行动作空间，支持自主决策与规划。
summary_en: Introduces the Business World Model (BWM), a world model specialized for business environments, encoding states, dynamics, constraints, objectives, and action space to enable autonomous planning and decision-making.
